heuristics.name: Direct Sovereign Partner Routing & Internal Authority
heuristics.rule: Decommission aggregator wrappers (Skimlinks) to eliminate the 25% middleman penalty. Route Tier-1 software directly to approved sovereign partner endpoints (Make 20% recurring, ElevenLabs 22%, Brevo, PartnerStack). Route unmanaged SaaS tools to internal technical reviews (/reviews/[slug]/) or alternative Tier-1 partners. Enforce strict stealth mode for the marketplace (no public routing or public links until explicit launch order).
heuristics.impact: Secures 100% direct revenue attribution without 25% aggregator deductions or third-party approval hurdles.

heuristics.name: Direct High-Yield Sovereignty
heuristics.rule: Never wrap active direct programs (Make 20%, ElevenLabs 22%, AdCreative, Murf, Brevo) with aggregators to preserve 100% net recurring revenue.
heuristics.impact: Maximizes MRR from top-converting software partners.

heuristics.name: Above-the-Fold Decision Hooks
heuristics.rule: Place clear recommendation banners and real TCO comparisons early in the article to capture high-intent buyers.
heuristics.impact: Improves outbound affiliate click-through rate from the first screen.

heuristics.name: Direct Sovereign Alternative Arbitrage
heuristics.rule: When inbound traffic navigates non-partner comparisons or unmonetized vendor pages (e.g., Zapier, legacy SMTP), recommend verified direct Tier-1 sovereign partners (e.g., Make.com, Brevo, ElevenLabs) using strictly verified /go/[slug] endpoints. The marketplace remains locked in stealth staging until explicit launch.
heuristics.impact: Maximizes conversion toward approved direct recurring programs with zero dead links.
